summary: Parked-up kerb backing onto a medical practice and trees; steep.

best_section.where: Morrow Street north kerb, beside the medical practice and tree strip

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto a commercial medical practice and a tree strip; nearest dwelling is apartments 26 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park nose to tail along this kerb, so a parking lane exists with room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with steady traffic and noise, but the van stands in the parking lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb in both images; a van would not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 10.9% grade, up to 15% locally
Noise: busy road and nearby fast-food outlet
sun_shade: Trees and the building shade it from the north-west; open to the afternoon sun otherwise.
